verdict.rationale: cubic provides its own diff inspection UI, which can hide test files and keeps group explanations beside the diff. It also runs automated AI review checks on PRs (bug and improvement comments, custom-agent rule enforcement, Ultrareview for risky changes) and a CLI that reviews uncommitted local changes before pushing. Community skepticism about AI review accuracy is general and does not concretely contradict these capabilities. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the checks reliably catch problems, and documented merge-gating (e.g., blocking status checks) tied to review findings.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Focus on implementation changes by hiding test files from the PR diff and file tree.
